tasks.label: MLflow UI
tasks.detail: Serve the local experiment store (data/mlflow) at http://127.0.0.1:5000
tasks.command: mkdir -p data/mlflow && if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5000) 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Port 5000 is already in use (MLflow UI probably running in another window): http://127.0.0.1:5000'; else exec "${userHome}/miniconda3/envs/transit_env/bin/mlflow" ui --backend-store-uri sqlite:///data/mlflow/mlflow.db --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5000; fi
